facts.fact: Clare 为再见到 Beck 该穿什么犹豫太久，结果自己迟到，站在俄式餐厅旋转门旁的雨棚下等
facts.anchor: I spend so much time dithering about what to wear

facts.fact: 她最后选了黑裙子和极少的首饰求稳，发现 Beck 也穿黑裙、头发挽起、戴大银圈耳环
facts.anchor: I finally opted for safety with a black dress and minimal jewelry

facts.fact: Beck 说自己吃素，点了罗宋汤和南瓜馅饼，Clare 点罗宋汤和土豆饼，并说自己不特别爱南瓜
facts.anchor: I’m a vegetarian, so it’s nice to see all the meat-free items

facts.fact: 环视满室红丝绒与镜子的餐厅后，Clare 意识到 Beck 是店里唯一的黑人
facts.anchor: I realize that she’s the only Black person in the restaurant

facts.fact: 谈话中途旋转门里出现一个赤裸的人，是三十多岁的 Alba，浑身湿透肮脏、长发缠结夹着灰白
facts.anchor: there’s a naked person in the revolving door of the restaurant

facts.fact: Clare 提醒她现在是 2010 年、彼此还不算认识，Alba 惊觉年份有误，借走外套与鞋打车离开
facts.anchor: it’s 2010 and we don’t really know

facts.fact: Beck 举杯说“To life, out of order”，Clare 回以 Henry 最爱的那句“To world enough, and time”
facts.anchor: It was Henry’s favorite toast, but it seems appropriate tonight

facts.fact: 散场后两人在雨棚下道别，Clare 在冰凉的春雨里感到未来开花，仍不确定这算不算约会
facts.anchor: I realize that this is what it’s like to choose someone
